title: Trump Pardons Adam Kidan Three Days After $2,600 Donation to Ryan Mackenzie Leadership PAC
description_short: Trump Pardons Adam Kidan Three Days After $2,600 Donation to Ryan Mackenzie Leadership PAC
description_medium: Federal records and contemporaneous reporting show that Adam Kidan donated $2,600 to Rep. Ryan Mackenzie's leadership PAC on June 30, 2026 and received a full presidential pardon on July 3. DOJ's clemency record lists Kidan's 2006 restitution order as $21,701,015.45. The timing is factual; available evidence does not establish that Mackenzie sought the pardon or that the contribution caused it.
description_long: Federal Election Commission records, as reported by Spotlight PA and NOTUS, show Adam Kidan gave $2,600 to Rep. Ryan Mackenzie’s leadership PAC on June 30, 2026. President Trump had campaigned with Mackenzie in Pennsylvania on June 23, and Trump issued Kidan a full pardon on July 3. The Justice Department clemency record lists Kidan’s 2006 restitution order as $21,701,015.45, correcting an earlier claim of $217 million. Mackenzie’s spokesperson said the congressman had never advocated for a pardon on anyone’s behalf; the report also says his office did not answer whether it would keep the donation. The White House said pardon requests receive review by DOJ and White House counsel, but did not address the specific relationship between the donation and pardon. The three-day sequence is documented and warrants accurate description. It does not, by itself, show that Mackenzie sought the clemency or that the contribution caused it. This account records the timing and reported responses without asserting a quid pro quo.
